summary: Shows post_tasks that re-enable the server in HAProxy and re-enable Nagios alerts via delegated loops after the update.
questions: How do I put a server back into the load balancer after updating it?
What do post_tasks do in a rolling update?

answer_card.title: Re-enabling the server with post_tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
post_tasks:
- shell: echo "enable server myapplb/{{ inventory_hostname }}" | socat stdio /var/lib/haproxy/stats
  delegate_to: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ groups.lbservers }}"
- nagios:
    action: enable_alerts
    host: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
    services: webserver
  delegate_to: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ groups.monitoring }}"
```

For NetScaler, F5 or ELB, substitute the matching modules.
